title: DR-8: app_components lists implemented components only
description: mls-extensions-10 §4.6: a client advertising app_data_dictionary 'MUST understand and advertise the app_components component'. Readings: (A) LeafNode app_data_dictionary carries an app_components (0x0001) entry listing the components the client supports; (B) as A, and the list also names 0x0001 itself. Open in both: which components to list. Chosen: A, listing only components actually implemented, plus one GREASE value (§5.1). The list grows as beads land safe_aad 0x0002, protocol-06 0x0020-0x0023 and room-policy-04 §10.1 components (extend in mimid-1wgh.4.3 and later).
notes:
Superseded 2026-10-18: reading B. mls-extensions-10 §4.6 'MUST understand and advertise the app_components component' -> LeafNode app_components lists 0x0001 itself (fix in mimid-1wgh.4.63).
Confirmed by Mark 2026-10-18: reading B; implemented in 7ea4456 (.4.63).
